sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Twenty-five selected parameters retain the preceding retention-site draws exactly. Reverse-carbonation factor is fixed at one, with permeability, pore radius, condensation factor, evaporation A/E and staged atmosphere also fixed. No reverse-kinetics or atmosphere-range robustness follows. Eight paired samples and unqualified physical/process cases yield exploratory rankings only; no measured material or qualified-process optimization. The ordered-structure viscosity barrier is fixed at 80000 J/mol; the same preceding 25 paired draws are retained. This does not establish robustness across the additional barrier range or identify that parameter. The dry-fraction modulus exponent is fixed at two; its range and correlation with reference modulus are not covered or identified. The matrix phase eigenstrain amplitude is fixed at 0.02; its signed range and correlation with phase kinetics or stiffness are not covered or identified. The coupled algebraic zero-relaxation limit is outside scope. Phase modulus contrast is fixed at four; neither its range nor its correlation with eigenstrain, porosity stiffness or phase kinetics is covered or identified. Disordered-minus-ordered heat capacity contrast is fixed at 10 J/mol/K; its range and correlations are neither covered nor identified. Phase conductivity contrast is fixed at two; its signed range and correlations with phase kinetics, baseline conductivity, moisture and pore radiation are not covered or identified. Tortuosity porosity exponent is fixed at one; its range and correlation with diffusivity, initial tortuosity, liquid occupancy and permeability are not covered or identified. Six positive gas-pair mobility factors are fixed at their declared nominal values; their ranges and correlations with the common diffusivity, tortuosity and permeability are not covered or identified. Mixture viscosity species factors and mixing fraction are fixed; their ranges, correlations and identifiability are not covered. Four new gas Cp slopes are fixed; their ranges and correlations are not sampled or identified. Six non-quartz dry background Cp slopes are fixed; ranges and correlations with kinetics, thermal and phase properties are not covered or identified. Liquid-water background Cp slope is fixed at 0.01 J/mol/K2; its range and correlation with retention, phase exchange and heat transfer are not covered or identified. The intrinsic dry-solid conductivity temperature exponent is also fixed; its declared range and correlation are not sampled or identified. Final-model refresh: carbonate phase resistance and pore-scale gas-pair resistance are explicitly fixed at their nominal values of one. Their ranges and correlations are not sampled or identified. Reuse the same 25-dimensional paired draws and three schedules; nominal permeability remains 3.75e-14 m2. Current-run results must be recorded separately from earlier ensembles; process and physical failures remain explicit.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

identities: Wilke Phi and species viscosity ratios are dimensionless; sum(y_i*mu_i/sum(y_j*Phi_ij))=Pa*s
-net_phase_rate*delta_mu/T=W/K; signed phase extent has units mol
outward_boundary_molar_flux*reservoir_mu/T=W/K; changing external y creates no internal inventory source
eta_dot=force/zeta=1/s; V0*force*eta_dot/T=W/K; positive zeta implies nonnegative mechanical dissipation
B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0=1; Bdot=B_n*ndot+B_x*xdot=1/s; fixed-x phase Cp=N*x*c=J/K; no double-counted equilibrium latent peak

scope.whole_cycle_meaning: Entire declared process window; a truncated stage configuration does not cover the omitted stages.

definitions.residual: End minus start inventory minus stoichiometric reaction net source minus boundary inflow plus boundary outflow; all amounts in mol.
definitions.budget_scale: max(abs(start inventory),abs(end inventory),sum(abs(each reaction interval net source)),abs(boundary in)+abs(boundary out)); no floors.
definitions.reference_scale: Initial inventory of this gas species at the start of the declared process window, reused for every stage; for a full-cycle configuration this is the full-cycle initial inventory. This normalization is distinct from the budget scale and is not the pass criterion.
definitions.boundary_direction: In/out label the theoretical nonnegative directional flux integrals. Recorded cumulative endpoint differences are used unchanged, including any small negative numerical increments; no clipping or absolute-value replacement is applied to balance amounts.
definitions.reaction_progress: Signed interval net reaction progress from cumulative extents; neither reaction sources nor their absolute sums measure gross forward/reverse traffic.
definitions.scope: Global internal faces cancel; endpoint residual only, not a local independent flux integration or the maximum residual within the interval.
definitions.verdict: Absolute residual divided by budget scale must be strictly below the existing acceptance.balance_relative. This report does not change prior conservation, physical or process-endpoint verdicts.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

definitions.verdict: Absolute residual divided by budget scale must be strictly below the existing acceptance.balance_relative. This report does not change prior conservation, physical or process-endpoint verdicts.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

identities: Wilke Phi and species viscosity ratios are dimensionless; sum(y_i*mu_i/sum(y_j*Phi_ij))=Pa*s
-net_phase_rate*delta_mu/T=W/K; signed phase extent has units mol
outward_boundary_molar_flux*reservoir_mu/T=W/K; changing external y creates no internal inventory source
eta_dot=force/zeta=1/s; V0*force*eta_dot/T=W/K; positive zeta implies nonnegative mechanical dissipation
B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0=1; Bdot=B_n*ndot+B_x*xdot=1/s; fixed-x phase Cp=N*x*c=J/K; no double-counted equilibrium latent peak

free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

scope.whole_cycle_meaning: Entire declared process window; a truncated stage configuration does not cover the omitted stages.

definitions.residual: End minus start inventory minus stoichiometric reaction net source minus boundary inflow plus boundary outflow; all amounts in mol.
definitions.budget_scale: max(abs(start inventory),abs(end inventory),sum(abs(each reaction interval net source)),abs(boundary in)+abs(boundary out)); no floors.
definitions.reference_scale: Initial inventory of this gas species at the start of the declared process window, reused for every stage; for a full-cycle configuration this is the full-cycle initial inventory. This normalization is distinct from the budget scale and is not the pass criterion.
definitions.boundary_direction: In/out label the theoretical nonnegative directional flux integrals. Recorded cumulative endpoint differences are used unchanged, including any small negative numerical increments; no clipping or absolute-value replacement is applied to balance amounts.
definitions.reaction_progress: Signed interval net reaction progress from cumulative extents; neither reaction sources nor their absolute sums measure gross forward/reverse traffic.
definitions.scope: Global internal faces cancel; endpoint residual only, not a local independent flux integration or the maximum residual within the interval.
definitions.verdict: Absolute residual divided by budget scale must be strictly below the existing acceptance.balance_relative. This report does not change prior conservation, physical or process-endpoint verdicts.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

definitions.reaction_progress: Signed interval net reaction progress from cumulative extents; neither reaction sources nor their absolute sums measure gross forward/reverse traffic.
definitions.scope: Global internal faces cancel; endpoint residual only, not a local independent flux integration or the maximum residual within the interval.
definitions.verdict: Absolute residual divided by budget scale must be strictly below the existing acceptance.balance_relative. This report does not change prior conservation, physical or process-endpoint verdicts.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

identities: Wilke Phi and species viscosity ratios are dimensionless; sum(y_i*mu_i/sum(y_j*Phi_ij))=Pa*s
-net_phase_rate*delta_mu/T=W/K; signed phase extent has units mol
outward_boundary_molar_flux*reservoir_mu/T=W/K; changing external y creates no internal inventory source
eta_dot=force/zeta=1/s; V0*force*eta_dot/T=W/K; positive zeta implies nonnegative mechanical dissipation
B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0=1; Bdot=B_n*ndot+B_x*xdot=1/s; fixed-x phase Cp=N*x*c=J/K; no double-counted equilibrium latent peak

scope.whole_cycle_meaning: Entire declared process window; a truncated stage configuration does not cover the omitted stages.

definitions.residual: End minus start inventory minus stoichiometric reaction net source minus boundary inflow plus boundary outflow; all amounts in mol.
definitions.budget_scale: max(abs(start inventory),abs(end inventory),sum(abs(each reaction interval net source)),abs(boundary in)+abs(boundary out)); no floors.
definitions.reference_scale: Initial inventory of this gas species at the start of the declared process window, reused for every stage; for a full-cycle configuration this is the full-cycle initial inventory. This normalization is distinct from the budget scale and is not the pass criterion.
definitions.boundary_direction: In/out label the theoretical nonnegative directional flux integrals. Recorded cumulative endpoint differences are used unchanged, including any small negative numerical increments; no clipping or absolute-value replacement is applied to balance amounts.
definitions.reaction_progress: Signed interval net reaction progress from cumulative extents; neither reaction sources nor their absolute sums measure gross forward/reverse traffic.
definitions.scope: Global internal faces cancel; endpoint residual only, not a local independent flux integration or the maximum residual within the interval.
definitions.verdict: Absolute residual divided by budget scale must be strictly below the existing acceptance.balance_relative. This report does not change prior conservation, physical or process-endpoint verdicts.

F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

eta_dot=force/zeta=1/s; V0*force*eta_dot/T=W/K; positive zeta implies nonnegative mechanical dissipation

F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

-net_phase_rate*delta_mu/T=W/K; signed phase extent has units mol
outward_boundary_molar_flux*reservoir_mu/T=W/K; changing external y creates no internal inventory source
eta_dot=force/zeta=1/s; V0*force*eta_dot/T=W/K; positive zeta implies nonnegative mechanical dissipation
B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0=1; Bdot=B_n*ndot+B_x*xdot=1/s; fixed-x phase Cp=N*x*c=J/K; no double-counted equilibrium latent peak

scope.whole_cycle_meaning: Entire declared process window; a truncated stage configuration does not cover the omitted stages.

definitions.residual: End minus start inventory minus stoichiometric reaction net source minus boundary inflow plus boundary outflow; all amounts in mol.

definitions.reaction_progress: Signed interval net reaction progress from cumulative extents; neither reaction sources nor their absolute sums measure gross forward/reverse traffic.

free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

definitions.reference_scale: Initial inventory of this gas species at the start of the declared process window, reused for every stage; for a full-cycle configuration this is the full-cycle initial inventory. This normalization is distinct from the budget scale and is not the pass criterion.
definitions.boundary_direction: In/out label the theoretical nonnegative directional flux integrals. Recorded cumulative endpoint differences are used unchanged, including any small negative numerical increments; no clipping or absolute-value replacement is applied to balance amounts.
definitions.reaction_progress: Signed interval net reaction progress from cumulative extents; neither reaction sources nor their absolute sums measure gross forward/reverse traffic.
definitions.scope: Global internal faces cancel; endpoint residual only, not a local independent flux integration or the maximum residual within the interval.
definitions.verdict: Absolute residual divided by budget scale must be strictly below the existing acceptance.balance_relative. This report does not change prior conservation, physical or process-endpoint verdicts.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

identities: Wilke Phi and species viscosity ratios are dimensionless; sum(y_i*mu_i/sum(y_j*Phi_ij))=Pa*s
-net_phase_rate*delta_mu/T=W/K; signed phase extent has units mol
outward_boundary_molar_flux*reservoir_mu/T=W/K; changing external y creates no internal inventory source
eta_dot=force/zeta=1/s; V0*force*eta_dot/T=W/K; positive zeta implies nonnegative mechanical dissipation
B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0=1; Bdot=B_n*ndot+B_x*xdot=1/s; fixed-x phase Cp=N*x*c=J/K; no double-counted equilibrium latent peak

definitions.reference_scale: Initial inventory of this gas species at the start of the declared process window, reused for every stage; for a full-cycle configuration this is the full-cycle initial inventory. This normalization is distinct from the budget scale and is not the pass criterion.
definitions.boundary_direction: In/out label the theoretical nonnegative directional flux integrals. Recorded cumulative endpoint differences are used unchanged, including any small negative numerical increments; no clipping or absolute-value replacement is applied to balance amounts.
definitions.reaction_progress: Signed interval net reaction progress from cumulative extents; neither reaction sources nor their absolute sums measure gross forward/reverse traffic.
definitions.scope: Global internal faces cancel; endpoint residual only, not a local independent flux integration or the maximum residual within the interval.
definitions.verdict: Absolute residual divided by budget scale must be strictly below the existing acceptance.balance_relative. This report does not change prior conservation, physical or process-endpoint verdicts.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

identities: Wilke Phi and species viscosity ratios are dimensionless; sum(y_i*mu_i/sum(y_j*Phi_ij))=Pa*s
-net_phase_rate*delta_mu/T=W/K; signed phase extent has units mol
outward_boundary_molar_flux*reservoir_mu/T=W/K; changing external y creates no internal inventory source
eta_dot=force/zeta=1/s; V0*force*eta_dot/T=W/K; positive zeta implies nonnegative mechanical dissipation
B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0=1; Bdot=B_n*ndot+B_x*xdot=1/s; fixed-x phase Cp=N*x*c=J/K; no double-counted equilibrium latent peak

scope.whole_cycle_meaning: Entire declared process window; a truncated stage configuration does not cover the omitted stages.

definitions.residual: End minus start inventory minus stoichiometric reaction net source minus boundary inflow plus boundary outflow; all amounts in mol.
definitions.budget_scale: max(abs(start inventory),abs(end inventory),sum(abs(each reaction interval net source)),abs(boundary in)+abs(boundary out)); no floors.
definitions.reference_scale: Initial inventory of this gas species at the start of the declared process window, reused for every stage; for a full-cycle configuration this is the full-cycle initial inventory. This normalization is distinct from the budget scale and is not the pass criterion.
definitions.boundary_direction: In/out label the theoretical nonnegative directional flux integrals. Recorded cumulative endpoint differences are used unchanged, including any small negative numerical increments; no clipping or absolute-value replacement is applied to balance amounts.
definitions.reaction_progress: Signed interval net reaction progress from cumulative extents; neither reaction sources nor their absolute sums measure gross forward/reverse traffic.
definitions.scope: Global internal faces cancel; endpoint residual only, not a local independent flux integration or the maximum residual within the interval.
definitions.verdict: Absolute residual divided by budget scale must be strictly below the existing acceptance.balance_relative. This report does not change prior conservation, physical or process-endpoint verdicts.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

definitions.reference_scale: Initial inventory of this gas species at the start of the declared process window, reused for every stage; for a full-cycle configuration this is the full-cycle initial inventory. This normalization is distinct from the budget scale and is not the pass criterion.
definitions.boundary_direction: In/out label the theoretical nonnegative directional flux integrals. Recorded cumulative endpoint differences are used unchanged, including any small negative numerical increments; no clipping or absolute-value replacement is applied to balance amounts.
definitions.reaction_progress: Signed interval net reaction progress from cumulative extents; neither reaction sources nor their absolute sums measure gross forward/reverse traffic.
definitions.scope: Global internal faces cancel; endpoint residual only, not a local independent flux integration or the maximum residual within the interval.
definitions.verdict: Absolute residual divided by budget scale must be strictly below the existing acceptance.balance_relative. This report does not change prior conservation, physical or process-endpoint verdicts.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

identities: Wilke Phi and species viscosity ratios are dimensionless; sum(y_i*mu_i/sum(y_j*Phi_ij))=Pa*s
-net_phase_rate*delta_mu/T=W/K; signed phase extent has units mol
outward_boundary_molar_flux*reservoir_mu/T=W/K; changing external y creates no internal inventory source
eta_dot=force/zeta=1/s; V0*force*eta_dot/T=W/K; positive zeta implies nonnegative mechanical dissipation
B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0=1; Bdot=B_n*ndot+B_x*xdot=1/s; fixed-x phase Cp=N*x*c=J/K; no double-counted equilibrium latent peak

Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

identities: Wilke Phi and species viscosity ratios are dimensionless; sum(y_i*mu_i/sum(y_j*Phi_ij))=Pa*s
-net_phase_rate*delta_mu/T=W/K; signed phase extent has units mol
outward_boundary_molar_flux*reservoir_mu/T=W/K; changing external y creates no internal inventory source
eta_dot=force/zeta=1/s; V0*force*eta_dot/T=W/K; positive zeta implies nonnegative mechanical dissipation
B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0=1; Bdot=B_n*ndot+B_x*xdot=1/s; fixed-x phase Cp=N*x*c=J/K; no double-counted equilibrium latent peak

scope.whole_cycle_meaning: Entire declared process window; a truncated stage configuration does not cover the omitted stages.

definitions.residual: End minus start inventory minus stoichiometric reaction net source minus boundary inflow plus boundary outflow; all amounts in mol.
definitions.budget_scale: max(abs(start inventory),abs(end inventory),sum(abs(each reaction interval net source)),abs(boundary in)+abs(boundary out)); no floors.
definitions.reference_scale: Initial inventory of this gas species at the start of the declared process window, reused for every stage; for a full-cycle configuration this is the full-cycle initial inventory. This normalization is distinct from the budget scale and is not the pass criterion.
definitions.boundary_direction: In/out label the theoretical nonnegative directional flux integrals. Recorded cumulative endpoint differences are used unchanged, including any small negative numerical increments; no clipping or absolute-value replacement is applied to balance amounts.
definitions.reaction_progress: Signed interval net reaction progress from cumulative extents; neither reaction sources nor their absolute sums measure gross forward/reverse traffic.
definitions.scope: Global internal faces cancel; endpoint residual only, not a local independent flux integration or the maximum residual within the interval.
definitions.verdict: Absolute residual divided by budget scale must be strictly below the existing acceptance.balance_relative. This report does not change prior conservation, physical or process-endpoint verdicts.
